notes.title: Touch Grass!
notes.notes:
Welcome netizens! 

After years of designing thousands of blades of grass, alas, the VR experience Touch Grass VR Simulator is ready for launch. Soon, you too, can enjoy the luxury of touching virtual grass in VR from the comfort of your home. Our collective subjugation to the everyday need to walk outside and touch real grass are over! Now, we may all enjoy the benefits of touching grass without succumbing to the dangers of the outside world! 

Touch Grass VR Simulator will be available to all VR grass touching enthusiasts in November 2024!
